results.title: NC News Roundup: Nor'easter rocks Outer Banks; changes to Medicaid coverage; changes to mail-in ballots challenged
results.description: Jeff Tiberii checks in with Corinne Saunders of the Outer Banks Insider about significant nor'easter damage. Mail-in ballot rules are challenged. Charlotte-Mecklenburg school board searches for a new superintendent. And we dissect some wacky campaign ads.

results.title: Trump set to name Jay Clayton as AI czar with safety fear rising - Fri, 02 Oct 2026 PST
results.description: President Donald Trump is expected to name U.S. Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton as his next artificial intelligence czar, according to a person familiar with the matter, tasking him with spurring the technology’s development even as it faces backlash over safety risks.

results.title: Keep capital's floodplains
results.description: The catastrophic city floods have brought the Bangkok Metropolitan Administration's (BMA) proposed land-use legislation into the public spotlight.

results.title: City floods expose gaps in governance
results.description: The latest flooding to hit Bangkok for almost two weeks may not compare with the 2011 mega flood, but the damage has exceeded expectations.

results.title: OAG urged to drop cases
results.description: Former red-shirt leader Nattawut Saikuar has asked the attorney-general to drop political cases covered by the new amnesty law, as the Office of the Attorney-General (OAG) prepares nationwide guidelines to ensure the law is applied equally.

results.title: Asean-China ties deepen further
results.description: Asean-China integration is already deep. Whether it produces durable, broadly shared gains will depend on the local linkages governments and firms build across Asean economies.
